premise.coldViewerWhyCare: People hesitate to use creatine because they worry about baldness.
premise.viewerQuestion: Does creatine actually cause hair loss?
premise.earlyPayoff: A 2025 trial measured actual hair and found no significant between-group difference.

beats.narration: Does creatine actually make you go bald?
beats.visualPurpose: Open at the scalp and transform the claim into a question.
beats.visualAction: Macro dolly through hair follicles as a false alarm icon appears.

beats.narration: A newer trial actually checked hair and found no significant difference.
beats.visualPurpose: Reveal the evidence payoff before discussing methodology.
beats.visualAction: Split-screen of labeled scalp outcomes comparing creatine and placebo, no invented numerical bars.

beats.narration: The rumor began with a two thousand nine study of a hormone called D H T.
beats.visualPurpose: Establish that the older result was a hormone surrogate.
beats.visualAction: Time-slider sweeps to 2009 and a DHT badge appears beside an empty hair-measurement column.

beats.narration: D H T went up after loading, but that study never measured hair loss.
beats.onScreenText: DHT +56% after loading | HAIR NOT TESTED
beats.visualPurpose: Attribute the original hormone number and distinguish it from hair.
beats.visualAction: DHT indicator rises and separates from a crossed-out hair measure.

beats.narration: In twenty twenty five, men took five grams of creatine or placebo daily for twelve weeks.
beats.visualPurpose: Explain tested treatment, population, and duration without implying a longer follow-up.
beats.visualAction: Calendar fills twelve weeks and capsules split into matched labeled arms.

beats.narration: They measured hair density, thickness, and follicle counts, without significant differences between groups.
beats.visualPurpose: Present the measured outcomes without fake numerical values.
beats.visualAction: A photographic scalp-style follicle illustration maps three labeled measures, then resolves to an evidence-neutral equals sign.

beats.narration: Only thirty seven men had usable hair data. Twelve weeks cannot settle long term risk.
beats.visualPurpose: Preserve sample-size and time-horizon limitations on screen.
beats.visualAction: Participants compress to thirty seven silhouettes and an unfinished timeline appears.

beats.visualPurpose: Offer a readable primary-study link as an independent evidence hold.
beats.visualAction: Display PubMed source on neutral high-contrast scientific card.

beats.narration: The evidence doesn't currently show that creatine causes baldness. Save this for your gym friend.
beats.visualPurpose: End with appropriately bounded synthesis and loop into the first claim.
beats.visualAction: Return through the same follicle tunnel into the original opening question.
